title: A bomb in a Black Market shop
description: In the Black Market, the player walks up to the Shopkeeper of Wang's Supply Shop and drops a lit bomb in the shop. "TERRORIST!": the Shopkeeper shoots him dead on the next step, and the market's other Shopkeepers are angered too.
